summary: Create the builtin Array entries iterator without snapshotting the array length.

semantics.length: read on each next step rather than snapshotted
semantics.mutation: appends before completion can be visited

tests.name: order
tests.expected_behavior: yields entries in ascending index order

tests.name: append observed
tests.input: const a=[1]; const it=a.entries(); console.log(String(it.next().value)); a.push(2); console.log(String(it.next().value));
tests.expected_behavior: second next observes the appended index/value before iterator completion
